company.name: Paystack
company.shortDescription: Paystack fintech company that facilitates online and offline payments for businesses across Africa.
company.description: Paystack lets businesses in Africa accept payments from anyone, anywhere in the world via credit card, debit card, money transfer, and mobile money on their websites or mobile apps. The platform offers easy-to-use features like linking bank accounts, sending money in a few steps, and saving recipients for quick payments. With Paystack, businesses can accept payments from customers anywhere in the world, enhancing their ability to grow and reach new markets.

productsAndServices.description: An online and offline payment platform that enables African businesses to accept card, bank, transfer, USSD, mobile money, QR, Apple Pay, and POS payments.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack Payment Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A set of APIs and developer tools for integrating payments, transfers, customer data retrieval, and identity verification into websites, applications, and financial products.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack APIs

productsAndServices.description: An in-person payments service for accepting card, bank transfer, and USSD payments through Paystack’s terminal and virtual terminal offerings.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack Terminal

productsAndServices.description: A commerce toolkit for selling physical and digital products online through storefronts, payment pages, order management, and inventory tools.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack Commerce

productsAndServices.description: A payout service for sending money to bank accounts individually or in bulk through the Paystack Dashboard or API.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack Transfers

productsAndServices.description: A merchant management dashboard for monitoring transactions, settlements, customers, reports, refunds, chargebacks, permissions, and reconciliation.
productsAndServices.name: Paystack Dashboard

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $10,205,002, or 87.41% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,577,878 to $38,036,456, a 24.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 55 (-35 over 90 days) and market heat at 82 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
